summary: Practise indicator checks, source verification, sampling and corrective action. Strengthen partner reporting evidence; explore the course outline.
lede: Programme data quality assessment gives MEAL and programme teams a structured way to verify reported indicators and trace supporting evidence. They can review indicator definitions, select practical samples, trace figures to source records and assess completeness, consistency and timeliness. The training also covers discrepancy analysis across partner reporting systems, corrective action documentation and organizing evidence for reporting reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, consolidate or report donor-funded programme indicators across implementing partners. It suits intermediate practitioners with working exposure to programme monitoring or routine reporting.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of programme monitoring, indicator reporting or partner data collection is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Spreadsheet familiarity will help you complete the Excel-based discrepancy exercises.
